ranking_rules: Rank operational notices from approved incident-management domains above unverified third-party reports.
Within the same authority class, rank by page_time from newest to oldest.
Use title and URL metadata only for the claims they explicitly support.
Title length is not a source-authority or freshness field.
verification_rules: Record each result's stable ID, exact title, URL host, site name, and page_time.
Flag a result as unverified when its host is not in the approved operational-domain list.
Flag a result as stale when an approved source has a newer incident update that conflicts with it.
Do not describe a freshness parameter as proof that the handler filtered or authenticated a result.
dispatch_boundary: Brief dispatchers from corroborated current official metadata and label unverified claims; do not claim access to article bodies or live fire telemetry.
